newsitem.title: USA: Farmers, ag leaders head Rural America for Dole.
newsitem.headline: Farmers, ag leaders head Rural America for Dole.

text.p: Six former U.S. secretaries of agriculture, agribusiness leaders and farmers will head the Rural America for Dole/Kemp National Steering Committee, it was announced Wednesday.
Creation of the committee was announced by campaign aides on the day Republican presidential nominee Bob Dole visited the Farm Progress Show at Amana, Iowa.

National honorary chairmen of the committee were the six living Republicans who served as agriculture secretary -- Clayton Yeutter, Richard Lyng, John Block, Jack Knebel, Earl Butz and Clifford Hardin.

Members of the national steering committee included H.D. Cleberg, president of Farmland Industries Inc ; Jack Gherty, chief executive office of Land O' Lakes; California Agriculture Secretary Ann Veneman, Illinois Agriculture Director Becky Doyle, Oklahoma Agriculture Secretary Dennis Howard and California Farm Bureau president Bob Vice.

Also on the committee were Iowa banker Bob Brenton, past president of the American Bankers Association, former Senator James Abdnor of South Dakota, Sam Hollis, a past president of the National Cotton Council, and former Deputy U.S. Agriculture Secretary Jack Parnell.
